# Dr. Cherise Dunn

Canonical URL: https://cherisedunn.github.io/personal-page-main/

Dr. Cherise Dunn is a founder-operator and strategic advisor helping institutions move healthcare innovation, AI adoption, digital manufacturing, and health equity strategies from concept to implementation.

## Advisory Focus

- AI adoption for healthcare institutions and health systems
- Digital and intelligent manufacturing for healthcare delivery
- Point-of-care medical device development and local production capability
- Health equity implementation and access models
- Cross-sector partnerships involving public institutions, universities, funders, and strategic partners

## Selected Proof

- Co-founder and COO, Makes Health / SOUTH AFRICA MAKES
- Healthcare innovation and digital manufacturing initiatives with more than $400K in funding and technology transfer support
- Platforms and affiliations include Harvard, UCT, G20 Startup20, BRICS, U.S. State Department IVLP, TEDx Cape Town, and MIT AI Ventures
- Recognition includes Fast Company South Africa, Inspiring Fifty Africa, BRICS Young Innovator finalist distinction, and Standard Bank Top Women recognition
